rss.title: Day 2 of TRAINING my CONFIDENCE
rss.description:
This video is part of my 30 Day Challenge of doing something embarrassing every day in order to build my self confidence, and not care about what others think about me as much.

I think everyone can use a healthy dose of self-embarrassment, and not take themselves too seriously at times. Not only is it good for feeling more free, it's also better for not judging others as much for being "weird." All of us have a little bit of weirdness inside of us that we're just too scared to let out.

minolee.mp4.title: “I could do this all day.”   -captain america i think   I hear this s...
minolee.mp4.description: “I could do this all day.”   -captain america i think   I hear this so often from my clients who wanna grow their personal brand.    “I need to hit my income goal in the next 60 days so I can finally ____!”   It’s this fear of being stuck where we are, that we chase our goal as desperately as possible to escape.    Yet, every time I’ve “chased…” …money …followers …validation …it always seems to be this frustratingly slow progression.    Meanwhile, the months where I’ve always made the biggest leaps:  - hitting my first $10,000 month with Content Academy - hitting my first $100,000 month with Content Academy   they were always oddly effortless.    and i know the feeling of wanting a dream so bad.   just scroll down to my posts in 2022 😭 bro i was down BADD   but there is nothing ickier and more repulsive to clients, viewers, and people…   than desperately NEEDING money, attention, or validation from them.   So comment unemployed already.   or… don’t.    I don’t care.    Wait… reverse psychology?? 😳

minolee.mp4.title: this is your sign to put all ur meetings on tuesdays   i stack all my...
minolee.mp4.description: this is your sign to put all ur meetings on tuesdays   i stack all my meetings onto tuesdays and wednesdays, so my calendar literally has nothing on all other days.   this allows me full days to work on videos. think creatively about our product. read a book. travel. hang out lol.    and it might sound like tuesdays become hell, but it’s oddly the opposite. it feels very rewarding the conquer a week of distractions in a hard day.    30 days til the launch of Content Academy 3.0, and i feel very good and productive. LFG.

minolee.mp4.title: day 5 / 35   We create the most prolific art, content, and businesses...
minolee.mp4.description: day 5 / 35   We create the most prolific art, content, and businesses when our ego is completely uninvolved in our creative process.  Our mind is really good at convincing us that you need to think in order analytically to create good art you need to be calculated   Data is helpful but only if it doesn’t make you emotional and influences your creative flow. The problem is emotions inevitably get swayed, especially when we have these bold dreams of becoming a full time creator.  How do you let go and simultaneously find success? First off is choosing one.  Saying I choose to be happy and playful and love what i create, and be fulfilled by what i create, more than I choose to become a rich creator.  And views inevitably follow, because you become a more compelling, less needy person on camera.

minolee.mp4.title: still trying to find more meaning in what i do   trying not to let wo...
minolee.mp4.description: still trying to find more meaning in what i do   trying not to let work consume me   trying to be more spiritual and present   trying to overcome a caffeine addiction 🤣   i always told myself that i would do ____ when i “make more money”   and not that i’ve reached that point of retirement money whatsoever (bru i’m not even close 😭 we did $100k/month in REV, and that was only one month)…   but reaching that symbolic milestone has made me question whether jumping right back into another behemoth of a goal would be smart   like now what? $1m/month?    so much of my life’s excitement in the past year has been derived in the chase of crazy goals.    but every day, i’m simultaneously scared of losing what i’ve built and scared of getting consumed by it.    in the past 2 months, to inject that kind of excitement again, i’ve started an ai business. i’ve planned a huge update to my coaching business Content Academy.    yet… are such goals just another form of dopamine-chasing, and addiction?   am i being a lazy b*tch?   idk stay tuned to see me either find happiness or crash out lol

minolee.mp4.title: how to make AI script videos that are authentically you 👇   1. Go to ...
minolee.mp4.description: how to make AI script videos that are authentically you 👇   1. Go to Goghost.ai and sign up bby   2. click “Add 📁” and paste the link of an “inspiration video” you wish to model your script structure around 3. click “Add 📁” and input a 1,000+ word document, transcript, or video link of your OWN ideas. This helps train Ghost AI to actually write authentically using your original sentences   4. paste THIS prompt into Ghost AI:    “Study how [INSPIRATION CREATOR] does their intro, and structures the script of their video. Write a full script for a Youtube video, using words DIRECTLY word-for-word from my [YOUR DATA] transcript, as they are authentically my words. Use as many words directly from my own transcript as possible, but still structure it within the scripting structure of [INSPIRATION CREATOR]’s video. Make the script around 5,000 words long. (1,000 words = ~3 minutes of video) Afterwards, give me 5 viral youtube video title ideas.“   5. Select “Use Inspiration” and be prepared to be amazed.

minolee.mp4.description: The reality of Instagram success is that it’s not about avoiding cringe; it’s about developing the grit to push through it.  The first six months will be challenging, filled with awkward angles, poor lighting, and potentially embarrassing ideas.  However, this is where you build the essential skills of content creation.  I personally went from being yes very cringe to building a fulfilling career. Therefore, abandon the excuses and start creating today.  What is one video idea that you have been putting off? Commit to completing it this week.
